title: FORMAT gives month and weekday names in English for en-US
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "mmm", FORMAT ( DATE ( 2020, 1, 2 ), "mmm" ), "mmmm", FORMAT ( DATE ( 2020, 1, 2 ), "mmmm" ), "ddd", FORMAT ( DATE ( 2020, 1, 9 ), "ddd" ), "dddd", FORMAT ( DATE ( 2020, 1, 9 ), "dddd" ) )
